HTTP Search Service v1 仅接受 query 和 topK，: HTTP Search Service v1 accepts only query and topK; it does not accept per-request strategies. The RAG service controls the effective strategy through DAP_RAG_SEARCH_MODE. DAP's saved strategy field is retained for compatibility and does not affect retrieval.
公共只读权限已默认开放，无需在角色中重复配置；此处仅配置角色的额外权限。: Public read-only permissions are already available by default and do not need to be added to roles. Configure only additional role permissions here.
删除参数可能影响码值解析和页面筛选。若参数暂时下线，建议优先禁用。: Deleting a parameter may affect code-value parsing and page filters. If it is temporarily unavailable, disable it instead.
删除用户后将无法恢复，相关历史审计记录仍会保留。若账号不再使用，建议优先禁用。: Deleted users cannot be restored; their historical audit records will remain. If the account is no longer used, disable it instead.
删除菜单会影响导航和权限配置。若菜单暂时不再使用，建议优先禁用。: Deleting a menu affects navigation and permission configuration. If it is temporarily unused, disable it instead.
删除角色后将无法恢复。后端会拒绝删除仍绑定用户的角色。: Deleted roles cannot be restored. The backend will reject deletion while users are assigned to the role.
只有受保护的管理配置页加载或管理员手动检查时才请求 /healthz 与 /re: Requests to /healthz and /readyz are made only when a protected administration page loads or an administrator runs a manual check; ordinary searches do not run diagnostics. Recommendation requests have a timeout. Remote-service errors, missing tokens, or catalog validation failures fail closed without affecting deterministic keyword search. DAP uses the HTTP Search Service v1 request and response format; the algorithm mode is configured on the RAG service.

已发起模型 HTTP 请求的成功、失败或取消问答均计一次；未发起模型请求的问答不: Each question that starts a model HTTP request counts once, whether it succeeds, fails, or is cancelled. Questions that do not start a model request do not consume quota. New LLM calls are rejected after the limit is reached.

模拟模式仅展示默认值，不读取或修改后端真实额度；切换到远端 API 模式后可管理: Mock mode displays defaults only and does not read or change the real backend quota. Switch to Remote API mode to manage persistent settings.

登录后访问系统管理: Sign in to access system management
系统管理、用户、角色、配置和操作日志仅对授权用户开放。: System management, users, roles, configuration, and operation logs are available only to authorized users.
统计至少发起一次真实 LLM Provider HTTP 请求的 AI 问答；每: Counts each AI question that starts at least one real LLM provider HTTP request, at most once per question, regardless of internal planning, answer generation, or retry request counts. The quota is shared across users and application instances, resets each calendar day in China Standard Time (Asia/Shanghai), and is not per-user or per-IP.

配置仍使用 AI_LLM_DAILY_LIMIT 参数编码并保存在现有系统参数表: The setting continues to use the AI_LLM_DAILY_LIMIT parameter code in the existing system parameter table. Counts are stored in the shared business database. Updates require system:param:write permission and are written to the operation audit log. Catalog COUNT queries, Mock questions, ordinary searches, and RAG recommendations do not consume this quota.
默认关闭。DAP 仅通过受认证的 HTTP 调用独立 RAG Search Se: Disabled by default. DAP only calls the standalone RAG Search Service over authenticated HTTP. DAP does not load models, read indexes, invoke RAG CLI or LLM, or generate AI answers. Keyword search does not wait for the recommendation service.
